## LmdbEnv.state property

Current lifecycle state of this env.

**Signature:**

```typescript
get state(): ILmdbEnvState;
```

## Remarks

The env opens on construction, so `state` is `'open'` immediately after `new LmdbEnv(...)`<!-- -->. After [LmdbEnv.close()](./lmdb.lmdbenv.close.md) it becomes `'closed'`<!-- -->.
